entities.name: Stanisław Pawlak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanisław Michał Pawlak is a Polish international law scholar and diplomat, ambassador of Poland to Canada (1978–1983), Syria (1996–2001), permanent representative to the United Nations (1989–1991), and judge of the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (2005–2023).
